install.procedure:
1) which agent-browser || npm i -g agent-browser
2) agent-browser install   # Chrome for Testing (first time)
3) cd <project> && npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-browser [--agent pi]
4) optional: add the Browser Automation block from the README to AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md
NOTE: agent-browser mcp (stdio) is an alternative integration for any MCP host — mcpServers: {"agent-browser": {command: "agent-browser", args: ["mcp"]}} merged into .mcp.json / .codex/config.toml / .pi/mcp.json.

npm rm -g agent-browser   # optional global prereq
agent-browser doctor       # official diagnose + auto-clean of stale daemon/browser files (browser/daemon dirs are tool-managed — path not doc-stated, honest-gap)

install.noClobber: Check-then-act: `which codebase-memory-mcp` before global install; MERGE the mcpServers key into existing .pi/mcp.json / .mcp.json / .codex/config.toml — never rewrite the whole file; if the key already exists, skip and diff. The upstream `codebase-memory-mcp install` (45-client user-scope installer incl. hooks/agents/daemon) is a DIFFERENT path — out of project scope; do not mix the two.
install.procedure:
1) which codebase-memory-mcp || npm i -g codebase-memory-mcp
2) merge mcpServers["codebase-memory-mcp"] into the project MCP config (per host; pi adds environment.CBM_CACHE_DIR=".codebase-memory/cache")
3) CBM_CACHE_DIR=.codebase-memory/cache codebase-memory-mcp cli index_repository '{"repo_path": "<abs>"}'
4) append the marker-fenced priority block to AGENTS.md
5) echo '.codebase-memory/' >> .gitignore

removal.procedure:
1) strip the AGENTS.md block BETWEEN the start/end markers (inclusive)
2) remove the mcpServers key (merge-safe JSON/TOML edit — file preserved)
3) rm -rf .codebase-memory
4) remove the .gitignore line
5) optional: npm rm -g codebase-memory-mcp
Verify every residueChecklist command. If the upstream user-scope installer was used instead, run `codebase-memory-mcp uninstall` (owned-entry tracking) — do NOT hand-edit its hooks/agents.
